(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const spawns = game.ctx.systems.spawns; spawns.debug.addPreset(window.__dwPreset('engineMicroburst', 'Engine microburst', [{ engine: 'windModifier', params: { sources: [{ type: 'downburst', fadeIn: 2 }, { type: 'curtain', length: 900, thickness: 300, top: 1500, downdraft: 8, fadeIn: 2 }] } }])); spawns.debug.addPreset(window.__dwPreset('engineGeyser', 'Engine geyser column', [{ engine: 'windModifier', params: { sources: [{ type: 'updraft', radius: 90, updraft: 14, top: 700, turbulence: 0.7, fadeIn: 0, timeline: { keys: [[0, 1], [6, 1], [8, 0], [14, 0], [15, 1]], loop: 15 } }] } }])); spawns.debug.addPreset(window.__dwPreset('engineRotor', 'Engine rough air', [{ engine: 'windModifier', params: { sources: [{ type: 'wake', direction: 'ambient', width: 3000, length: 6000, base: -200, top: 4000, deficit: 2, turbulence: 1, gust: 6, fadeIn: 0 }] } }])); spawns.debug.addPreset(window.__dwPreset('engineGustFront', 'Engine gust front', [{ engine: 'windModifier', params: { type: 'gustFront', drift: 12, fadeIn: 0 } }])); spawns.debug.addPreset(window.__dwPreset('engineJet', 'Engine jet stream', [{ engine: 'windModifier', params: { sources: [{ type: 'jetStream', altitude: 300, length: 8000, bend: 600, speed: 30, fadeIn: 0 }] } }])); window.__dwBaseline = { memory: window.__dwMemory(), sources: game.ctx.wind.sourceCount, stats: spawns.getStats().engines.windModifier }; return window.__dwCheck('wind modifier engine registered and initialised', window.__dwBaseline.stats && !window.__dwBaseline.stats.failed && window.__dwBaseline.stats.instances === 0, JSON.stringify(window.__dwBaseline)); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const spawns = game.ctx.systems.spawns; const heading = game.ctx.state.player.heading; window.__dwIds = { microburst: spawns.manager.activate('engineMicroburst', { position: window.__dwAhead(1500, -20), heading, source: 'debug', force: true }), geyser: spawns.manager.activate('engineGeyser', { position: window.__dwAhead(900, 25), heading, source: 'debug', force: true }), jet: spawns.manager.activate('engineJet', { position: window.__dwAhead(2500, 0), heading, source: 'debug', force: true }), gustFront: spawns.manager.activate('engineGustFront', { position: window.__dwAhead(3000, 10), heading: heading + 180, source: 'debug', force: true }), }; const frontStart = spawns.getInstance(window.__dwIds.gustFront).position; window.__dwFrontStart = { x: frontStart.x, z: frontStart.z }; const stats = spawns.getStats().engines.windModifier; const own = window.__dwOwn(); const ok = Object.values(window.__dwIds).every(Boolean) && stats.instances === 4 && own.sources === 5 && game.ctx.wind.sourceCount === window.__dwBaseline.sources + 5 && stats.drawCalls === 0; return window.__dwCheck('four wind modifier spawns with five sources (one drifting toward the craft)', ok, JSON.stringify({ ids: window.__dwIds, stats, engineSources: own.sources, sources: game.ctx.wind.sourceCount })); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const ctx = game.ctx; const spawns = ctx.systems.spawns; const V = ctx.THREE.Vector3; const burst = spawns.getInstance(window.__dwIds.microburst).position; const geyser = spawns.getInstance(window.__dwIds.geyser).position; const front = spawns.getInstance(window.__dwIds.gustFront).position; const start = window.__dwFrontStart; const drifted = Math.hypot(front.x - start.x, front.z - start.z); const sink = ctx.wind.probe(new V(burst.x, burst.y + 700, burst.z)); const lift = ctx.wind.probe(new V(geyser.x, geyser.y + 250, geyser.z)); const ok = sink.vel.y < -6 && sink.turbulence > 0.2 && lift.vel.y > 5 && lift.vel.y < 20 && drifted > 15; return window.__dwCheck('the microburst sinks, the geyser column lifts on its schedule, the gust front drifts', ok, JSON.stringify({ microburstUp: Math.round(sink.vel.y * 10) / 10, microburstTurbulence: Math.round(sink.turbulence * 100) / 100, geyserUp: Math.round(lift.vel.y * 10) / 10, gustFrontDrift: Math.round(drifted) })); })()
(() => { const ctx = window.DRIFTWING.ctx; ctx.settings.set('windOverlay', true); ctx.setPhotoMode(true); return 'wind arrows on, photo mode (the simulation and terrain streaming stand still)'; })()
(() => { const point = window.DRIFTWING.ctx.systems.spawns.getInstance(window.__dwIds.microburst).position; return 'look at the microburst: ' + window.__dwLook(point, 400, 70); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const ctx = game.ctx; const spawns = ctx.systems.spawns; ctx.settings.set('windOverlay', false); window.__dwPhotoMemory = window.__dwMemory(); const ended = ['microburst', 'geyser', 'jet', 'gustFront'].filter((key) => spawns.deactivate(window.__dwIds[key], 'test')).length; return window.__dwCheck('the four wind modifier spawns deactivated in photo mode', ended === 4, `${ended} of 4`); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const ctx = game.ctx; const spawns = ctx.systems.spawns; const memory = window.__dwMemory(); const before = window.__dwPhotoMemory; const ok = memory.geometries === before.geometries && memory.textures === before.textures && ctx.wind.sourceCount === window.__dwBaseline.sources && window.__dwOwn().sources === 0; ctx.setPhotoMode(false); return window.__dwCheck('dispose removes their five sources; the engine holds no GPU memory', ok, JSON.stringify({ withSpawns: before, afterDispose: memory, sources: ctx.wind.sourceCount })); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const ctx = game.ctx; const spawns = ctx.systems.spawns; const player = ctx.state.player; window.__dwIds.rotor = spawns.manager.activate('engineRotor', { position: { x: player.position.x, y: player.position.y - 800, z: player.position.z }, heading: player.heading, source: 'debug', force: true }); const anchor = spawns.getInstance(window.__dwIds.rotor).position; const direction = ctx.uniforms.windDirection.value; ctx.systems.flight.resetTo({ x: anchor.x + direction.x * 1500, y: player.position.y, z: anchor.z + direction.y * 1500, heading: player.heading }); ctx.systems.camera.setView('cockpit'); return 'the craft placed in rough air (turbulence 1), cockpit view'; })()

(() => { const ctx = window.DRIFTWING.ctx; const flight = ctx.state.flight; const shake = ctx.systems.camera.getStats().turbulenceShake; window.__dwShake = shake; const audio = ctx.systems.audio.getStats(); const rattle = audio.turbulenceRattle ?? null; const ok = flight.turbulence > 0.6 && shake.amount > 0.2 && audio.state === 'running' && rattle !== null && rattle.interior && rattle.amount > 0.2 && rattle.levels.rattle > 0.01; return window.__dwCheck('rough air at the craft shakes the cockpit camera and rattles the cockpit', ok, JSON.stringify({ turbulence: Math.round(flight.turbulence * 100) / 100, shake, audio: audio.state, rattle })); })()

(() => { const ctx = window.DRIFTWING.ctx; const shake = ctx.systems.camera.getStats().turbulenceShake; const rattle = ctx.systems.audio.getStats().turbulenceRattle ?? null; ctx.setPhotoMode(false); return window.__dwCheck('photo mode switches the turbulence shake and the rattle off', shake.amount < 0.05 && rattle !== null && rattle.amount === 0 && rattle.levels.rattle < 0.005, JSON.stringify({ shake, rattle })); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const spawns = game.ctx.systems.spawns; game.ctx.systems.camera.setView('chase'); const ended = spawns.deactivate(window.__dwIds.rotor, 'test') ? 1 : 0; return window.__dwCheck('the rough-air spawn deactivated', ended === 1, `${ended} of 1`); })()

(() => { const game = window.DRIFTWING; const spawns = game.ctx.systems.spawns; const stats = spawns.getStats(); const kinds = new Set(['spawn-downburst', 'spawn-curtain', 'spawn-updraft', 'spawn-wake', 'spawn-jetStream', 'spawn-gustFront']); const added = window.__dwSources.filter((event) => event.type === 'added' && kinds.has(event.kind)).length; const removed = window.__dwSources.filter((event) => event.type === 'removed' && kinds.has(event.kind)).length; const shake = game.ctx.systems.camera.getStats().turbulenceShake; const ok = game.ctx.wind.sourceCount === window.__dwBaseline.sources && added === 6 && removed === 6 && stats.engines.windModifier.instances === 0 && window.__dwOwn().sources === 0 && stats.leaks.windSources === 0 && shake.amount < 0.05; return window.__dwCheck('every wind source removed (windSourceAdded / windSourceRemoved pair up); calm air again', ok, JSON.stringify({ sources: { before: window.__dwBaseline.sources, after: game.ctx.wind.sourceCount, added, removed }, leaks: stats.leaks, windModifier: stats.engines.windModifier, shake })); })()
